Achievements have all kinds of completion conditions, and clearing them earns rewards!

Rewards include things like <color=#ff3bc8>Holomem Rank EXP, Titles, and Red Diamonds!</color>

When you Train a Member, <color=#ff3bc8>the level cap increases</color>!

Items needed for training can be obtained from Live and Holowork!

Holomem Quests start when you talk to a holomem you can meet today in Dream Park!

<color=#ff3bc8>Two meetable holomems are chosen at random </color>each day!

You can also <color=#ff3bc8>use Invite Tickets to increase the number of holomems you can meet</color>!
Invite Tickets can be obtained in Main Quests, and more!

You can also play the Holomem Quest for the holomem you chose when starting the game!

Complete Holomem Quests to <color=#ff3bc8>unlock the featured holomem and Songs!</color>

<color=#ff3bc8>Unlocked holomems become playable in Dream Park.</color>

You can change the active holomem!

<color=#ff3bc8>You can choose from holomems you've unlocked via Holomem Quests</color>!

holomems can <color=#ff3bc8>change outfit and equip accessories</color>!

Outfits can be obtained from Gacha, and accessories can be obtained from things like the Mission Pass!
Mega Circuit <color=#ff3bc8>can be played at anytime in the Games Area</color>!

Your <color=#ff3bc8>best clear times</color> will be recorded in the rankings!

* In case of identical best clear times, earlier ones will take precedence.

Mega Circuit is an <color=#ff3bc8>obstacle race where a maximum of 16 holomems compete</color>!
Dodge through various traps and aim for the finish line faster than anyone else!

<color=#ff3bc8>You will get different rewards depending on your skills</color>! 

Do your best and aim for the top position!

▼Controls Guide
Jump: <color=#ff3bc8>Tap to make your holomem jump</color>.

Dash: <color=#ff3bc8>Tap to make your holomem temporarily dash</color>.

* You can't dash again until the gauge refills.
Pokajan! <color=#ff3bc8>can be played at anytime in the Casino Area</color>!

"Your <color=#ff3bc8>Total Coins Rating</color> will be recorded in the rankings!

This rating calculates the total number of Mega Sphere Coins you've gained or lost throughout your play history!

* The result of each play session is calculated as [end result coins - 1,000].
* The rating is not affected by the increase in rewards that comes from bigger bets.
* In case of identical ratings, the earlier ones are given priority."

Pokajan! is a card game played with four players!

Every turn, draw a card until <color=#ff3bc8>you make a power hand</color>！

The player who has the <color=#ff3bc8>most coins at the end</color> will be the winner!

A hand is formed when you <color=#ff3bc8>collect 3 of the same holomem, or collect the entire group</color>!

If you have a complete hand, <color=#ff3bc8>push the Pokajan! button and earn coins from other players</color>!

If all the cards in the hand are the same color, you earn even more coins!

After hitting Pokajan! you can draw additional cards equal to your hand!

<color=#ff3bc8>If you refill your cards and complete another hand, you can pull off back-to-back Pokajan!</color>

If you fail to make a hand, play 1 card from your hand and end your turn!

<color=#ff3bc8>Even if the other player played their card, you can Pokajan</color>!

However, if multiple players Pokajan! at the same time, the person with the strongest hand will earn the coins!

If there are multiple players with the tying strongest hands, <color=#ff3bc8>priority goes to the nearest in clockwise direction to the player who was Pokajan!’d</color>!

<color=#ff3bc8>The game ends when the deck runs out of cards or someone runs out of coins!</color>

Your final ranking is based on how many coins you have!

You will receive rewards based on your ranking and number of coins!
Collect Cooking <color=#ff3bc8>can be played at anytime in Tarafuku Journey</color>!

There are <color=#ff3bc8>3 types of modes</color> to play in Collect Cooking!

▼Modes
・EASY: Clear by completing the required number of dishes.
・NORMAL: Clear by completing the required number of dishes.
・SCORE ATTACK: Aim to get the Best Score.

* You can view the unlock conditions for NORMAL & SCORE ATTACK by tapping on each mode.

In Score Attack Mode, <color=#ff3bc8>complete the designated dishes, earn points, and aim for the best score!</color>

Play until the ingredients overflow from the tray or the timer reaches 0!

Match the specified ingredients consecutively to earn a <color=#ff3bc8>score bonus</color>!

Your <color=#ff3bc8>Score Attack Mode</color> best score will be recorded in the rankings!

* If the best score are identical, the first one will take precedence.

<color=#ff3bc8>Collect specific ingredients and finish cooking</color> within the time limit!

Tap on the ingredient and move it to the tray, <color=#ff3bc8>collect 3 of the same ingredients to progress with cooking</color>!

<color=#ff3bc8>It’ll be game over if the ingredients overflow from the tray</color>, so be careful!

<color=#ff3bc8>You will get different rewards depending on your cooking skills</color>!

Do your best and prepare lots of dishes!

▼ Controls
Shuffle: <color=#ff3bc8>Tap to shuffle ingredient positions.</color>

* Once you shuffle, you can't use again until the gauge refills.
<color=#ff3bc8>Share the charts you’ve made and play music made by people all over the world</color>!
You can create a Chart from scratch,<color=#ff3bc8> or referencing Official Charts or Charts from other players with permission</color>!

Select Notes and position them wherever you please!

<color=#ff3bc8>After positioning them, you can move them or change their width</color>!

Select a Note using the arrow icon on the right and choose Options to <color=#ff3bc8>flip the Note or perform various other actions</color>!

Tap the arrow icon again <color=#ff3bc8>to select the range</color>!

If you want to delete a Note, tap the eraser icon to <color=#ff3bc8>select and delete placed Notes</color>!
<color=#ff3bc8>If you press and hold in the Editor</color>, a menu will open, allowing you to access various commands!

You can change Long Notes into straight or curved lines!

<color=#ff3bc8>You can position Mid Notes between the start and end points of Long Notes, and there are 3 different types</color>!

You can place Decorative Notes like Long Notes that are purely for visual purposes and don't need to be tapped.

Choose a color before positioning, whichever color you like!

<color=#ff3bc8>You can access all the settings for the Editor menu by tapping the gear icon in the bottom-left corner</color>!

For more details on Editor functions, you can view the How to Play in the upper right corner!

At NePoLaBo Mart, you can exchange Hologold for various items, or sell some items you own.

<color=#ff3bc8>Items have exchange limits and exchange deadlines</color>, so trade for what you need early!
At the Material Exchange Shop, you can trade <color=#ff3bc8>your items for others</color>!

At the Mega Sphere Coin Exchange, you can <color=#ff3bc8>exchange Mega Sphere Coins for all sorts of items</color>!

Collect Mega Sphere Coins and exchange them!

You can also <color=#ff3bc8>exchange Minigame Boost for Mega Sphere Coins</color>!

Come here when you need some Mega Sphere Coins!
You can check currently active events on the Event Portal.

Achievements have all kinds of completion conditions, and clearing them earns rewards!

Rewards include things like <color=#ff3bc8>Holomem Rank EXP, Titles, and Red Diamonds!</color>

Leveling up a Member <color=#ff3bc8>increases their parameters</color>!

Lesson Pts for leveling up can be earned from Holowork, NePoLaBo Mart, and more!

When you Train a Member, <color=#ff3bc8>the level cap increases </color>!

Items needed for training can be obtained from Live and Holowork!

When you Bloom a Member, <color=#ff3bc8>their skills and Connect effects are upgraded</color>!

Each Member can be Bloomed <color=#ff3bc8>up to 5 levels</color>!

You can earn Bloom Pts by obtaining duplicates of the same Member!

In the holomem List, you can check each holomem's unlock status.

<color=#ff3bc8>Clear Holomem Quests to unlock holomems you haven't unlocked yet</color>!

You can add Friends by the following methods!

▼How To Add Friends
・Send another player a friend request and have them accept it.
・Accept a friend request from another player.

You can send friend requests from their profile and accept them from Approve Request menu.
Once you're Friends, <color=#ff3bc8>you can invite them to a Multiplayer Room</color>! You can even take a look at their profile from your Friends List!

The Holomem Score Rating is calculated from the <color=#ff3bc8>high score you achieve when playing with a vocalist as the leader</color>!

The total of the top 3 Song ratings combined is recorded as each Holomem's Score Rating!

Also, your Ranking Badge in the Holomem Score Rating will be updated every week in accordance with your results!

*Ranking Badges are given out based on your Rank at the timing of ranking calculation, and will be removed in case you are outside the eligible threshold at the timing of the next calculation.
<color=#ff3bc8>Jump on time so you don't get hit by the jump rope!</color>

<color=#ff3bc8>The speed and way the jump rope moves will change and sometimes the screen will be obscured</color>, so watch out!

Pay attention to the holomem spinning the rope!

<color=#ff3bc8>You will get different rewards depending on your jumping skills</color>!

Hop a lot and aim for the top!

▼Controls Guide
Jump: <color=#ff3bc8>Tap to make your holomem jump</color>.

* Press and release the Jump quickly to perform a quick jump.

In Multiplayer, you can play with up to 5 players and aim for a longer challenge.

You can <color=#ff3bc8>revive out players</color> by filling up the gauge!

The gauge will fill up slowly as others jump!

Your <color=#ff3bc8>Score Attack Mode best score, or the highest number of jumps you've made in multiplayer</color>, will be recorded in the rankings!

* If the best scores are identical, the first one will take precedence.

<color=#ff3bc8>Jump on time so you don't get hit by the jump rope!</color>

<color=#ff3bc8>You have 3 lives! </color>Once reach 0 the game is over so be careful!

<color=#ff3bc8>You will get different rewards depending on your jumping skills</color>!

There are <color=#ff3bc8>3 different difficulty modes</color> you can try in Solo Mode.

▼Mode
・EASY: Last longer than other holomem to clear.
・NORMAL: Last longer than other holomem to clear.
・SCORE ATTACK: A challenge to aim for your best score.

Tap on the Normal or Score Attack modes to check the unlock conditions!

Your <color=#ff3bc8>Score Attack Mode best score, or the highest number of jumps you've made in multiplayer</color>, will be recorded in the rankings!

* If the best scores are identical, the first one will take precedence.

A Unit is made up of <color=#ff3bc8>a Leader and five Members.</color>

The Unit Score is determined by the Leader's skills, and the Members' parameters, skills, and more!

UP to 10 units can be registered per Leader.

Join a holomem Membership to receive all sorts of cool perks!

<color=#ff3bc8>Each holomem has Menshi Medals</color> you get as a sign-up bonus that can be exchanged for lots of holomem perks!

<color=#ff3bc8>Exchanged perks can be used even after canceling Membership.</color>

The Mission Pass allows you to <color=#ff3bc8>earn various rewards by increasing your Mission Level</color>!

There are two Mission Pass types, the Free Pass, and the Premium Pass, which you unlock by subscribing!

<color=#ff3bc8>Once you unlock the Premium Pass, you’ll be able to receive rewards for levels you’ve already surpassed</color>!

<color=#ff3bc8>Complete Missions and collect Mission Pts!</color>
Collect enough and you can level up!

When the Mission Pass period ends, <color=#ff3bc8>Mission Pass Pts and Level reset</color>, so be careful!

Unclaimed rewards after the Mission Pass period ends, will be sent to your Gifts!

Minigame multiplayer has a <color=#ff3bc8>Free Mode that anyone can join</color>!

If you want to play with friends, create a room from [Create Room], and share the ID with friends to play!
Tap on the <color=#ff3bc8>"?" on the Minigame selection screen to see how to play</color>!

Multiplayer Live can be played with <color=#ff3bc8>up to 5 players</color>.

The Song you play is chosen <color=#ff3bc8>randomly from the songs each player selects</color>!

Each player can freely choose their own difficulty.

In Multiplayer Live, there is a <color=#ff3bc8>Fever that increases the score you earn</color>!

Break into Fever when all participating players fill the <color=#ff3bc8>Fever Gauge</color>!
The Score Ranking in Multiplayer Live is <color=#ff3bc8>determined by everyone's total score</color>!

Multiplayer Live have two modes: <color=#ff3bc8>Free Mode that anyone can join</color>, and <color=#ff3bc8>Graded Mode that only players above a certain Unit Score can join</color>!

If you want to play with friends, create a room from [Create Room], and share the ID with friends to play!

The Song you play is chosen <color=#ff3bc8>randomly from the songs each player selects</color>!

Each player can freely choose their own difficulty.

In the Song Shop, you can exchange Music Disks for Songs!

<color=#ff3bc8>Songs you exchanged can then be played in Live!</color>

You can change the active holomem!

<color=#ff3bc8>You can choose from holomems you've unlocked via Holomem Quests</color>!

holomems can <color=#ff3bc8>change outfits and equip accessories</color>!

Outfits can be obtained from Gacha, and accessories can be obtained from things like the Mission Pass!

High & Low is a <color=#ff3bc8>card game where you BET Mega Sphere Coins to play</color>.

Make a power hand with 5 cards in your hand, and if you complete a hand, you can test your luck with the High & Low Double Up Chance!

In Double Up Chance, guess whether the next card you draw will be higher or lower than the previous one you drew.

If you succeed at <color=#ff3bc8>Double Up Chance, you get double the Coins</color>!

<color=#ff3bc8>If you fail Double Up Chance, you will earn 0 Coins</color>, so think long and hard before you take the leap!

If the card you draw is the same number, you can redraw.

On High & Low, <color=#ff3bc8>there is a limit in the number of coins you can win in 1 game as well as the number of coins you can win in a day</color>!

▼Limit of coins that can be won on High & Low
・Number of coins that can be won in a game: <color=#ff3bc8>Up to 10,000</color>
*The moment the number of coins won surpasses 10,000 the game will end.
*Coins exceeding 10,000 can also be obtained.

・Number of coins that can be won in a day: <color=#ff3bc8>Up to 20,000</color>
*Once the number of coins won in a day surpasses 20,000, that day High & Low will become unavailable to play. It will became playable the following day.
*Coins exceeding 20,000 can also be obtained.

<color=#ff3bc8>You can set Members & Memories you earned at the Memory Stand</color>.

Set up your favorite Members & Memories and decorate Dream Park!
<color=#ff3bc8>Collect Memories to increase your Unit parameters.</color>

Complete Main Quests <color=#ff3bc8>to progress through the main story</color>!

If you're not sure what to do next, continue on the Main Quests.

Holomem Quests start when you talk to a holomem you can meet today in Dream Park!

<color=#ff3bc8>Two meetable holomems are chosen at random </color>each day!

You can also <color=#ff3bc8>use Invite Tickets to increase the number of holomems you can meet</color>!
Invite Tickets can be obtained in Main Quests, and more!

You can also play the Holomem Quest for the holomem you chose when starting the game!

Complete Holomem Quests to <color=#ff3bc8>unlock the featured holomem and Songs!</color>

<color=#ff3bc8>Unlocked holomems become playable in Dream Park.</color>

Area Quests appear as you <color=#ff3bc8>complete Main Quests and fulfill certain conditions</color>!

Complete quests to earn all sorts of rewards!

Daily Quests <color=#ff3bc8>are quests that refresh everyday</color>!

They reset everyday, so don’t forget to challenge them!

Score Rankings are rankings based on each Song's high score in Solo Mode!

<color=#ff3bc8>This is a record of the highest score you achieved for that song, regardless of difficulty level</color>.
If your Score Ranking score matches another player's the ranking is determined on a first-come, first-served basis.

In the Shop, you can purchase Blue Diamonds, items, and more!

There's also subscription services like Membership and HoloPassport, which grant various perks when you join!

At the Holosticker Exchange, you can exchange Holosticker them for various items!

▼How To Obtain Holosticker & Amount
・If Gacha Pt exchange period expires: 1Pt = 1 Sticker

・Fully Bloomed ★3 Member = 1 Sticker

・Fully Bloomed ★4 Member = 20 Stickers
* This also includes ★3 & ★4 Members that have the required Bloom Pts to fully Bloom.

At the Special Holosticker Exchange, you can exchange Special Holosticker them for various items!

▼How To Obtain Special Holosticker & Amount
・Not Fully Bloomed ★5 Member = 30 Stickers

・Fully Bloomed ★5 Member = 130 Stickers
* This also includes ★5 Members that have the required Bloom Pts to fully Bloom.

By unlocking Tiles on the Holomem Board for each Holomem, <color=#ff3bc8>you can gain many kinds of effects during Live & Minigames</color>!

▼ Tile Types
・Leader Type (Red Tiles): Its effect can be used when assigned to a unit Leader.

・Member Type (Blue Tiles): Its effect can be used when assigned to a unit member.

・Support Type (Yellow/Green Tiles): Even when not assigned to a unit it’s effect can be used.

・Connect Nodes: Connect effects activate when you place Members on Connect Tiles.

You can earn the Cubes you need to unlock Nodes<color=#ff3bc8> through exchanging, Holowork, and more</color>!

You can receive <color=#ff3bc8>Holomem Board Points by increasing your Holomem Rank</color>!

Earn the required EXP to rank up by completing each holomem’s Achievements!
At HOLO Cinemas, look back on stories you've experienced and watch special promotional videos!

View your player info in Profile.

<color=#ff3bc8>Come here to edit your player name, Status Message, Custom Card, and Title</color>!

In Custom Profile, <color=#ff3bc8>you can freely arrange parts</color> on a base of your choice!

You can save up to 20 custom profiles, including the default one!

<color=#ff3bc8>Dream Rank increases by completing Quests, hitting achievements, and more.</color>

Raise your Dream Rank to earn all sorts of cool rewards!

To start Holowork, you will first need to put Members in a formation.

<color=#ff3bc8>After the designated time passes</color>, they will finish work, and you will be able to reap the Rewards!

The activity content will be updated when the update time in the upper left becomes 0!

<color=#ff3bc8>The higher your total power, the better you'll do, leading to more rewards</color>.
The higher the evaluation, the better rewards you earn!

Each activity has Prime Members, and they will receive parameter boosts.

Link your account to share your save game data between multiple devices.
If the device already contains save data, you share to overwrite current save data.

※ Please beware that previous save data cannot be retrieved if overwritten when the account has not been linked.

When you Train a Member, the level cap increases.

Items needed for training can be obtained from Live and Holowork!

You can consume Lesson Pts to level up Members.
Leveling up a Member increases their parameters.

Lesson Pts for leveling up can be earned from Holowork, NePoLaBo Mart, and more.

Each member possesses three of the following skills.

▼Member skills
・Special Skill: A powerful skill that can activated once during a Live (order of activation is determined by formation order).
・Active Skill: A skill that activates randomly during Live at a certain intervals.
・Passive Skill: A skill that constantly provides an effect if conditions are met.

Bloom members to level up Skill effects.
Connect effects activate when you place Members on <color=#ff3bc8>Connect Nodes on the Holomem Board and unlock the Tiles within the effect range</color>.

Increase your Holomem Rank by collecting Holomem Rank EXP!

<color=#ff3bc8>Rank up to earn Holomem Board Pts</color>!

Holomem Rank Exp can be obtained by hitting corresponding holomem's Achievements!
<color=#ff3bc8>Level up assigned members</color> to raise up the Unit Score!

<color=#ff3bc8>The higher the Unit Score, the easier it is to meet the clear requirements </color>!

Clear requirements are ranked in the following order [×>△>〇>★], with ★ being the easiest to clear!

<color=#ff3bc8>If the clear requirement is [×], you won’t be able to attempt a Live</color>, so start by upgrading your Unit!

Unlock your leader’s Holomem Board to raise your Unit Score!

It’s recommended to unlock the <color=#ff3bc8>leader type’s red Nodes</color>!
<color=#ff3bc8>Level up assigned members</color> to raise up the Unit Score!

Some Outfit Skills won’t activate unless some conditions are met!

<color=#ff3bc8>Let’s take a look at your Outfit Skills and if you meet the activation conditions</color>!

Unit Score is a parameter that serves as the metric for Live Scores.
The higher the Unit Score, the bigger increase of score that can be earned during Live.

The Unit Score is the value obtained by applying the Score Bonus to your Total Power.

▼Total Power
・Member’s Parameters: Combined Parameter of the assigned members.
・Outfit Skill: Outfit Skill (Parameter UP) effect amount.
・Holomem Board Effect: Holomem Board (Parameter UP) effect amount.
・Passive Skill: Passive Skill (Score Bonus) effect amount.
・Memory Effect: Bonus effect based on number of Memories owned.
・Member Upgrade Bonus: Bonus amount from member upgrades.

▼Score Bonus
・Outfit Skill: Outfit Skill (Score Bonus UP) effect.
・Active Skill: Active Skill effect.
・Holomem Board Effect: Holomem Board (Score Bonus UP) effect 
・Passive Skill: Passive Skill (Score Bonus UP) effect.
・Special Skill: Special Skill effect.

*Not applicable effects will not be displayed.

Check this box to allow matching with players who have enabled Auto-Play.
Uncheck this box to only be matched with players who have not enabled Auto-Play.

This setting applies to all matching, including each mode and Private Rooms.

You can change Lane and Background brightness.

Increase this number to brighten the display, but this may reduce Note visibility.
You can set to display effects to ON/OFF while Active Skill is active.

You can choose holomem illustrations to be displayed when the Live Background is set to Illustration.

▼Random
The Members assigned in your Unit will be displayed at random.

▼Center Fixed
The 3rd assigned member from the left(center) of your Unit will be displayed.

You can set the default Live Background for songs that don’t have a MV.

You can choose the Background that is displayed during Live on the Unit Setup menu before starting a Live.

You can set the combo counter background display according to the current combo status.
